long_biography.plain_text:
Born into the family behind Niagara Bottling, Peykoff was the seventh of eight children. He joined the company after studying at Southern Methodist University. When his father suffered a stroke, Peykoff assumed day-to-day leadership at twenty-six and immersed himself in the operational detail of bottling, packaging and distribution.

Under Peykoff, Niagara expanded from a regional producer into a national private-label supplier. He pursued vertical integration, high-speed automation and lighter bottle designs to lower costs while adding production facilities closer to customers. The strategy allowed the family-controlled company to scale across the United States while preserving its emphasis on affordable water, manufacturing efficiency and direct retailer relationships.
